MORARJEE.NS.d: Morarjee Textiles Limited manufactures and sells yarns and fabrics in India and internationally. The company primarily offers premium cotton shirting fabrics. It also provides printed fabrics, including satin, cambric, poplin, lawn, and silk; and yarn dyed shirting, voiles, and white fabrics. The company was founded in 1871 and is based in Mumbai, India. Morarjee Textiles Limited is a subsidiary of Ashok Piramal Group Textiles Trust.

MUFTI.NS.d: Credo Brands Marketing Ltd. is a retailer of men's casual apparel in India, best known for its MUFTI brand. Its collection spans shirts, t-shirts, pants, sweatshirts, denim, chinos, jackets, blazers and sweaters, for everyday, urban, party and athleisure styles. Founded in 1998, it is based in Mumbai.

OFSS.NS.d: Oracle Financial Services Software Limited provides information technology (IT) solutions and business processing services to the financial services industry worldwide. It operates through three segments: Product Licenses and Related Activities, IT Solutions and Consulting Services, and Business Processing Outsourcing Services.

OSWALGREEN.NS.d: Oswal Greentech Ltd. mainly develops property in India through two divisions: real estate and investments. It also trades real estate assets, and its investment arm puts capital into equities and other financial securities and provides inter-corporate deposits. It was founded in 1981.

PIGL-SM.NS.d: POWER & INSTRUMENT is a company that specializes in power and instrumentation solutions. The company likely provides engineering services, equipment supply, and maintenance support related to power generation and industrial instrumentation. The specific nature of its activities and services would require further research.

PRITIKA.NS.d: Pritika Engineering Components Ltd. specializes in the manufacturing of precision machined components for the automotive industry. The company's primary products, derived from iron castings and forgings, include a range of critical parts such as rear axle housings, differential cases, hydraulic lift covers, wheel hubs, front engine and axle supports, flywheel housings, and transmission covers. These components are designed for applications in tractors, commercial vehicles, and material handling equipment.

PRLIND.NS.d: Premier Roadlines Ltd. engages in the provision of logistics solutions. It offers general transportation services, project logistics, oversized and overweight cargo transportation across India. The company was founded by Nand Ram Gupta in 1986 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

REDINGTON.NS.d: Redington (India) Limited provides supply chain solutions for information technology products, telecom, lifestyle, healthcare, and solar products in India and internationally.

SADHNANIQ.NS.d: Sadhana Nitro Chem Ltd. produces and supplies chemical intermediates, heavy organic compounds and high-performance chemicals, and also provides wireless network equipment and services. Its business is split into domestic sales in India and export sales. Dhankumar T. Javeri founded it on July 21, 1973, and it is headquartered in Mumbai.

SPIC.NS.d: Southern Petrochemical Industries Corporation Limited manufactures and sells fertilizers in India and internationally. The company operates through Agro inputs - Urea Operations and Others - Agri Business segments.

SRTRANSFIN-ZG.NS.d: Sec Red NCD 8.85% Sr.IV represents a secured, redeemable, non-convertible debenture issued by Shriram Transport Finance Limited, offering a fixed interest rate of 8.85% and belonging to Series IV of the issuance; it is a debt instrument used by the company to raise capital from the public; Shriram Transport Finance Limited is an asset financing NBFC focused on providing financing solutions to commercial vehicle owners.

STYLAMIND.NS.d: Stylam Industries Limited, based in Chandigarh and established in 1991, produces decorative laminated sheets for residential and industrial uses in India and abroad. It was previously known as Golden Laminates Ltd., and its range includes solid, compact, exterior-grade, high-gloss and anti-fingerprint laminates.

TCC.NS.d: TCC Concept Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker TCC and traded in INR. Its country is India.

TNPL.NS.d: Tamil Nadu Newsprint and Papers Limited manufactures and sells paper and paper boards in India. The company operates through Paper & Paper Board, Energy, and Cement segments. It offers surface-sized and non-surface sized papers for printing and writing; and coated and uncoated boards under the AURA brand for the packing industry. The company also generates power through TGs and wind mills. In addition, it manufactures and sells cement.

TRF.NS.d: TRF Limited designs, manufactures, and sells material handling products and systems for infrastructure industries in India and internationally. The company's Bulk Material Handling Equipment division designs and manufactures various material handling equipment used in the infrastructure industries, such as wagon tipplers, stacker reclaimers, traveling wagon loaders, screen, crushers, etc.

VARROC.NS.d: Varroc Engineering Limited designs, manufactures, and supplies exterior lighting systems, plastic and polymer components, electrical and electronics components, and precision metallic components worldwide. It operates through Automotive and Others segments.

VIJAYA.NS.d: Vijaya Diagnostic Centre Limited offers diagnostic services to patients across India. Its laboratory work covers biochemistry, haematology, pathology, microbiology, serology, cytogenetics and molecular pathology, and its imaging includes MRI, CT, mammography, bone densitometry, ultrasound, PET/CT and digital X-ray. It also provides cardiology and neurology services.

VISAMAN.NS.d: Visaman Global Sales Ltd. operates as a business-to-business (B2B) supplier specializing in the trading and distribution of industrial products within the steel and metal industry.

WAAREERTL.NS.d: Waaree Renewable Technologies Limited is an Indian company that produces electricity using renewable methods. It offers solar solutions including ground-mounted, rooftop and floating solar installations, through capital expenditure (CAPEX) models and RESCO operational expenditure models.

WENDT.NS.d: Wendt (India) Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells super abrasives, high precision grinding, honing, special purpose machines, and high precision components in India and internationally. The company operates through two segment, Super Abrasives; and Machines, Accessories and Components.
